coordinateModel: per-source affine longitude/latitude; inverse of projection applied to image bounds

overlap.meaning: Rectangle intersection only; not proof that rendered roads, labels, or landmarks agree.

registration.fitting: Not performed. Existing projection parameters retained.

heldOutAnchorSet.reason: No independent held-out street-intersection coordinates are retained for these two maps. Source-derived pins or fit anchors cannot validate geographic accuracy.

frozenCriteria.readability: At all three zoom levels, inspect source artwork and neutral base context on both sides of the crossing; require distinct street paths, no duplicated/conflicting road or place labels, and visible context through the overlap and one deliberately unillustrated gap. Any ambiguous road continuation or landmark displacement is a fail.
frozenCriteria.ownership: Review the crossing in full-art and each authored spotlight mode; spotlight edges are aesthetic emphasis, never neighborhood eligibility edges.
frozenCriteria.independence: Freeze a minimum of 8 named street intersections per image (4 near the footprint edges and 4 internal), sourced from independently documented street-centerline data. Reserve at least 4 further intersections per image for held-out validation; do not tune on those points.
frozenCriteria.status: Criteria recorded before fitting; the named independent coordinates must be added and hashed before any fitting begins.

limits: Rectangular overlap is not a visual seam or registration finding.
Source spotlight masks retain the SVG visual-emphasis geometry, including its authored stroke; they are not official neighborhood boundaries.
No held-out geographic accuracy or seamless cross-map ownership has been established.

sourceRoadAgreement.method: All vertices from retained named source road features are measured to the nearest segment among County road features with exactly equal normalized full names. Distances use a local equirectangular metric approximation centered on each vertex.
sourceRoadAgreement.normalization: Case/punctuation insensitive; numeric ordinal and spelled ordinal normalization; full direction and road-type words normalize to County abbreviations. No substring or partial-token matching.
limitations: This is broad source-road agreement, not independent held-out intersection validation. The source coordinates and County lines are separate retained datasets, but this report does not validate the affine image transforms or fit/correct them.

Name-matched lines may be only partial county coverage. Missing names and vertices beyond the County context bounds are not treated as accuracy failures or omitted from the reported missing-name counts.
Every source vertex is weighted equally; distances are to nearest same-name County line segment, not necessarily the corresponding segment along a long or repeated street name.
